meta_title: Firmware partners · The projects our boards run on
meta_description: OpenDrone ships on Betaflight, AM32 and ExpressLRS. Who they are, how to donate to them directly, and how Incutec supports them.
title: We are nothing without firmware
lead: Every OpenDrone board runs on community firmware we did not write. We support these projects as far as our profits allow.
s1_body: Every product page names the firmware its board runs and links to the project and its donation page.
On our side: we pay the regular sums that come with certifying our hardware for their projects, and we make public donations when the numbers allow it.
partner_betaflight_blurb: Betaflight is the flight controller firmware used in most small multirotor aircraft.
partner_am32_blurb: AM32 is a multi-MCU ESC firmware alternative to BLHeli.
partner_expresslrs_blurb: ExpressLRS is the open 2.4 GHz / 900 MHz radio control link protocol.
s4_body: Money is one half; patches are the other. These are our changes that upstream actually merged: every link goes to the real PR.
